    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "source": [
        "import pandas as pd\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import CountVectorizer\n",
        "from sklearn.naive_bayes import MultinomialNB\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create Dataset\n",
        "reviews = [\n",
        "    \"The movie is amazing\",\n",
        "    \"I loved the acting\",\n",
        "    \"Excellent story and great music\",\n",
        "    \"Fantastic film\",\n",
        "    \"I enjoyed every minute\",\n",
        "    \"Worst movie ever\",\n",
        "    \"I hate this movie\",\n",
        "    \"Waste of time\",\n",
        "    \"Very boring movie\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "sentiments = [\n",
        "    \"Positive\",\n",
        "    \"Positive\",\n",
        "    \"Positive\",\n",
        "    \"Positive\",\n",
        "    \"Positive\",\n",
        "    \"Negative\",\n",
        "    \"Negative\",\n",
        "    \"Negative\",\n",
        "    \"Negative\"\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "# Create DataFrame\n",
        "df = pd.DataFrame({\n",
        "    \"Review\": reviews,\n",
        "    \"Sentiment\": sentiments\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "# Save CSV\n",
        "df.to_csv(\"Movie_Reviews.csv\", index=False)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Movie Review Dataset\")\n",
        "print(df.to_string(index=False))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Bar Graph\n",
        "count = df[\"Sentiment\"].value_counts()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6,4))\n",
        "plt.bar(count.index, count.values)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Movie Review Sentiment - Bar Graph\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Sentiment\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Count\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Pie Chart\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(6,6))\n",
        "plt.pie(count.values,\n",
        "        labels=count.index,\n",
        "        autopct=\"%1.1f%%\",\n",
        "        startangle=90)\n",
        "plt.title(\"Movie Review Sentiment - Pie Chart\")\n",
        "plt.show()\n",
        "\n",
        "# Convert labels\n",
        "df[\"Sentiment\"] = df[\"Sentiment\"].map({\n",
        "    \"Positive\":1,\n",
        "    \"Negative\":0\n",
        "})\n",
        "\n",
        "# Train Model\n",
        "vectorizer = CountVectorizer()\n",
        "X = vectorizer.fit_transform(df[\"Review\"])\n",
        "y = df[\"Sentiment\"]\n",
        "\n",
        "model = MultinomialNB()\n",
        "model.fit(X, y)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Predict New Review\n",
        "test_review = [\"Amazing movie with excellent acting\"]\n",
        "test = vectorizer.transform(test_review)\n",
        "prediction = model.predict(test)\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"\\nNew Review:\", test_review[0])\n",
        "\n",
        "if prediction[0] == 1:\n",
        "    print(\"Prediction: Positive Review\")\n",
        "else:\n",
        "    print(\"Prediction: Negative Review\")"
      ],
